text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm starving~.
GⅠ races really do work up an appetite, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, I lost!
One shio ramen, please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, soy sauce ramen for me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* And here I thought
I was gonna show 'em what I've got today.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"'In today's Arima Kinen held at Nakayama Racecourse,
which Umamusume caught your attention
among the runners?'"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "‘Machikane Tannhauser and Tokai Teio were fantastic, but personally, I thought Nice Nature was amazing!’"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"You could feel her fired up from the paddock,
and her running in the race was magnificent as well!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"She missed out on 1st place, but...
we can look forward to her future achievements even more!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...*Hmph*, she says!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...
Well, I gave it everything I had!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Nature was incredible.
I felt shivers running down my back.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Easy for you to say when you're the one who won.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature stared up at the ceiling for a moment—
then patted her cheeks to psych herself up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next! Next time's the one!
Next time, I'm definitely taking 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's good. Very positive.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Whose words do you think you're parroting?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the ramen is here! Is it soy sauce broth?
I'm digging in first!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*munch*...
Mmm, so deli—huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry.
I think this one might've been the shio ramen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey!
